summary: The Style tab / ctxbar sub-control for a raw folded toneLaw (e.g. bundleDither) showed its descriptor DEFAULT instead of the sibling value the canvas already renders. Rank-1 fix: SCENE_FILL_STYLES.displayParams seeds the DISPLAY bag from ALIASES; both UI surfaces now read the seeded bag while writes are untouched.

tier_a_cell.note: General render-path smoke test, unrelated to bundleDither/contFieldTouch specifically — proves the fix (config + 2 UI files) did not disturb the shared gallery render path at all.

bespoke_canvas_crop.scene: object3d sphere, mapper=hatch, style.params.toneLaw='bundleDither', built via engine.addLayer('scene3d') -> exportState -> importState (reopened document)
bespoke_canvas_crop.crop_box_fraction: x:0.30-0.70, y:0.30-0.70 of the canvas bounding box, deviceScaleFactor 2
bespoke_canvas_crop.explanation: This unit touches ONLY src/config/context-bar.js (a new displayParams function), src/ui/panels/scene3d-panel.js (one read-site line), and src/ui/shell/context-bar.js (the styleParams sub-control loop + its mixed closure) — no engine, algorithm, or renderer file. Params.normalizeParams inside algo.generate (scene3d.js:1191) already resolved bundleDither correctly before this fix (measured in the plan, R5 pins it). A byte-identical canvas pair is therefore the EXPECTED result, not a false negative.

docked_style_tab.before: Fill Style = 'Bundle · Count' (correct, untouched), Bundle mode = 'Integer pass count' (WRONG — the raw bag's toneLaw is 'bundleDither', so the panel should show Dithered). No caveat row (U5b's effectiveLaw is not merged into this lane, so caveat absence is expected pre- AND post-fix here — not a regression).
docked_style_tab.after: Fill Style unchanged ('Bundle · Count'). Bundle mode now reads 'Dithered' — the value the canvas has been rendering all along. Still no caveat row (unchanged — this unit does not touch that mechanism; see plan §2 vs U5b).

ctxbar_style_flyout.before: Same lie as the docked panel: Fill Style = 'Bundle · Count', Bundle mode = 'Integer pass count'.
ctxbar_style_flyout.after: Bundle mode = 'Dithered'; Fill Style unchanged. Visually identical row layout/copy to the docked panel, confirming both surfaces read off the same seeded bag.

contfield_overfix_guard.before: Field metric = 'Screen metric', Field floor = 'Plot floor' (WRONG — raw toneLaw is 'contFieldTouch', so Field floor should read the ink-width option).
contfield_overfix_guard.after: Field metric UNCHANGED at 'Screen metric' (over-fix guard holds — the seed only fills undefined keys, and fieldMetric was never part of contFieldTouch's alias.params). Field floor now reads 'Ink-width floor' — correct.

canvas.both: Sphere, hatch fill, dithered bundle banding visible (the bundleDither mark). Selection handles/gizmo overlay present (object selected for the panel shot). Before and after renders are pixel/byte-identical (md5 match) — the canvas never lied and this unit does not move it.
